name: pieter-vibejam
description: A web game for Pieter Levels' Vibe Coding Jam — React + Three.js + Colyseus (TypeScript)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "yarn workspace @vibejam/client dev" "yarn workspace @vibejam/server dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace @vibejam/shared build && yarn workspace @vibejam/client build && yarn workspace @vibejam/server build
scripts.build:client: yarn workspace @vibejam/shared build && yarn workspace @vibejam/client build
scripts.build:server: yarn workspace @vibejam/shared build && yarn workspace @vibejam/server build
